title: Fix Corsair Dark Core RGB Pro pairing failure
summary: If a Corsair Dark Core mouse fails to pair with an AuthenticationCanceled error, limit the Bluetooth adapter to 1M PHY mode.

steps.explain: Check the current PHY settings of the adapter.
Set the adapter to use only 1M PHY modes, removing LE2M and Coded PHY options. This command forces the adapter to use the more compatible 1M PHY.
steps.cmd: sudo btmgmt phy BR1M1SLOT BR1M3SLOT BR1M5SLOT EDR2M1SLOT EDR2M3SLOT EDR2M5SLOT EDR3M1SLOT EDR3M3SLOT EDR3M5SLOT LE1MTX LE1MRX

steps.explain: If the mouse is already listed, remove it using bluetoothctl.
Put the mouse in pairing mode (switch off, hold profile button, switch to BT) and pair it again using bluetoothctl or your desktop settings.

warnings: This setting limits ALL LE devices on the adapter to 1M PHY.
The kernel may reset this setting on reboot or Bluetooth toggle.

rollback.explain: Restore default PHY settings by powering the adapter off and on, or rebooting.
